decisions.choice: your counted ones from twenty years old and upward: the men of the census
decisions.reason: These are the men counted in chapter 1, everyone twenty years old and upward who could go out to war (1:3, 45-46). The census was taken to prepare the army that would take the land; now the same list names those who will die in the wilderness. The new census in chapter 26 confirms it (26:64-65).

decisions.choice: corpses: dead bodies
decisions.reason: The word is the plain word for a dead body. Repeated in verses 32 and 33, it makes the sentence stark: the people will not only die but lie dead in the wilderness they chose.

decisions.choice: bodies / dead bodies
decisions.reason: Balanced says "bodies" and Readable "dead bodies"; Literal keeps "corpses".

decisions.choice: will die
decisions.reason: Readable adds "will die" at the end so the long list can stand as a clear sentence.

source.text: אִם־אַתֶּם֙ תָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֨אתִי֙ אֶת־יָדִ֔י לְשַׁכֵּ֥ן אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּ֑הּ כִּ֚י אִם־כָּלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֔ה וִיהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ בִּן־נֽוּן׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely not you will come into the land which I lifted my hand to make dwell you in it, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

en.L: Surely you will not come into the land which I lifted up {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand to settle you in it, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
en.B: You will certainly not enter the land that I raised {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} hand and swore to give you as a home, except for Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
en.R: None of you will go into the land I solemnly promised to give you as your home. Only Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun will go in.

es.L: Ciertamente {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no {{plural_you:entrarán|entraréis}} en la tierra sobre la cual alcé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano para {{plural_you:hacerlos|haceros}} habitar en ella, excepto Caleb hijo de Jefone y Josué hijo de Nun.
es.B: De ninguna manera {{plural_you:entrarán|entraréis}} en la tierra por la que alcé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} mano y juré {{plural_you:darles|daros}} como hogar, excepto Caleb hijo de Jefone y Josué hijo de Nun.
es.R: Ninguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} entrará en la tierra que prometí solemnemente {{plural_you:darles|daros}} como hogar. Solo entrarán Caleb hijo de Jefone y Josué hijo de Nun.

fr.L: Certainement vous n’entrerez pas dans le pays au sujet duquel j’ai levé {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} main pour vous y établir, excepté Caleb fils de Jephounné et Josué fils de Noun.
fr.B: Vous n’entrerez certainement pas dans le pays que j’avais juré, la main levée, de vous donner pour demeure, excepté Caleb fils de Jephounné et Josué fils de Noun.
fr.R: Aucun de vous n’entrera dans le pays que j’avais promis solennellement de vous donner pour y habiter. Seuls Caleb, fils de Jephounné, et Josué, fils de Noun, y entreront.

sw.L: Hakika ninyi hamtaingia katika nchi niliyoinulia mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} kuwakalisha ndani yake, isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.
sw.B: Hakika hamtaingia katika nchi ambayo niliinua mkono {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} nikaapa kuwapa iwe makao yenu, isipokuwa Kalebu mwana wa Yefune na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni.
sw.R: Hakuna hata mmoja wenu atakayeingia katika nchi niliyoahidi kwa kiapo kuwapa iwe makao yenu. Ni Kalebu mwana wa Yefune na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni tu watakaoingia.

decisions.choice: I lifted up my hand: I swore
decisions.reason: Raising the hand was the gesture of taking an oath (Genesis 14:22; Exodus 6:8; Deuteronomy 32:40). God's oath about the land stands, but this generation will not share in it.

decisions.choice: surely you will not come: an oath
decisions.reason: As in verse 23, the oath word "if" means "surely not". The sentence goes on from "so I will do to you" (verse 28).

decisions.choice: to settle you in it: to make you live there
decisions.reason: The verb means to cause to dwell, to give a settled home. It is related to the word for the tabernacle, where God himself dwells among them.

decisions.choice: raised my hand and swore (Balanced); solemnly promised (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the gesture and adds "swore" to say what it meant; Readable gives the meaning only.

source.text: וְטַ֨פְּכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֖ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֑ה וְהֵבֵיאתִ֣י אֹתָ֔ם וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר מְאַסְתֶּ֖ם בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And your little ones, whom you said would become plunder, and I will bring them in, and they will know the land which you have rejected.

en.L: And your little ones, whom you said would become plunder, I will bring them in, and they will know the land which you have rejected.
en.B: But your little ones, who you said would be carried off as spoil, I will bring in, and they will come to know the land you have rejected.
en.R: You said your children would be captured. But I will bring them into the land, and they will live in the land you refused.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pequeños, de los que {{plural_you:dijeron|dijisteis}} que serían botín, yo los introduciré, y conocerán la tierra que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:han rechazado|habéis rechazado}}.
es.B: Pero a {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pequeños, de quienes {{plural_you:dijeron|dijisteis}} que serían llevados como botín, a ellos los haré entrar, y llegarán a conocer la tierra que {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:han rechazado|habéis rechazado}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes dijeron|Vosotros dijisteis}} que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos serían capturados. Pero yo los llevaré a la tierra, y ellos vivirán en la tierra que {{plural_you:ustedes rechazaron|vosotros rechazasteis}}.

fr.L: Et vos petits, dont vous avez dit qu’ils deviendraient un butin, je les y ferai entrer, et ils connaîtront le pays que vous avez rejeté.
fr.B: Mais vos petits enfants, dont vous disiez qu’ils seraient emmenés comme butin, je les y ferai entrer, et ils connaîtront le pays que vous avez rejeté.
fr.R: Vous avez dit que vos enfants seraient capturés. Mais {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je les ferai entrer dans le pays, et ils habiteront dans le pays que vous avez refusé.

sw.L: Na watoto wenu wadogo, mliosema watakuwa nyara, nitawaingiza, nao wataijua nchi mliyoikataa.
sw.B: Lakini watoto wenu wadogo, ambao mlisema watachukuliwa kama nyara, nitawaingiza, nao wataijua nchi mliyoikataa.
sw.R: Mlisema watoto wenu watatekwa. Lakini {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nitawaingiza katika nchi hiyo, nao wataishi katika nchi mliyoikataa.

decisions.choice: your little ones, whom you said would become plunder: God answers verse 3
decisions.reason: The people used their children as the reason not to go in (verse 3). God turns their words around: the children they said would be captured will be the ones who enter.

decisions.choice: they will know the land: they will come to have it and live in it
decisions.reason: To "know" in Hebrew often means to experience something for oneself, not only to learn about it. The children will live in and enjoy the land their parents only heard about.

decisions.choice: rejected: refused with contempt
decisions.reason: The verb means to reject or despise something as worthless. The land God called good and the people refused is what their children will have.

decisions.choice: they will live in the land
decisions.reason: Readable says what "know the land" means here.

source.text: וּפִגְרֵיכֶ֖ם אַתֶּ֑ם יִפְּל֖וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And your corpses, you, will fall in the wilderness the this.

en.L: But your corpses, you, will fall in this wilderness.
en.B: But as for you, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.
en.R: But you yourselves will die here in the desert.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cadáveres, {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, caerán en este desierto.
es.B: Pero en cuanto a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos caerán en este desierto.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} mismos {{plural_you:morirán|moriréis}} aquí en el desierto.

fr.L: Mais vos cadavres, à vous, tomberont dans ce désert.
fr.B: Mais quant à vous, vos corps tomberont dans ce désert.
fr.R: Mais vous, vous allez mourir ici, dans le désert.

sw.L: Lakini maiti zenu, ninyi, zitaanguka katika nyika hii.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi, miili yenu itaanguka katika nyika hii.
sw.R: Lakini ninyi wenyewe mtakufa hapa jangwani.

decisions.choice: your corpses, you: emphasis set against the children
decisions.reason: The extra "you" stresses the contrast with verse 31: your children will enter, but you, your bodies will fall here.

decisions.choice: But as for you (Balanced); you yourselves (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable carry the emphatic "you" with an English phrase of contrast.

source.text: וּ֠בְנֵיכֶם יִהְי֨וּ רֹעִ֤ים בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה וְנָשְׂא֖וּ אֶת־זְנוּתֵיכֶ֑ם עַד־תֹּ֥ם פִּגְרֵיכֶ֖ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And your sons will be shepherds in the wilderness forty year[s], and they will bear your prostitutions until are finished your corpses in the wilderness.

en.L: And your {{gender:children|sons}} will be shepherds in the wilderness forty years, and they will bear your prostitution until your corpses are finished in the wilderness.
en.B: Your {{gender:children|sons}} will roam the wilderness as shepherds for forty years, bearing the burden of your unfaithfulness, until every one of your bodies has fallen in the wilderness.
en.R: Your {{gender:children|sons}} will live as shepherds in the desert for forty years. They will suffer because you were not faithful to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, until the last of you has died in the desert.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hijos serán pastores en el desierto cuarenta años, y cargarán con {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} prostitución hasta que se acaben {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cadáveres en el desierto.
es.B: {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} hijos andarán como pastores por el desierto durante cuarenta años, cargando con el peso de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} infidelidad, hasta que el último de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} cuerpos haya caído en el desierto.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sus|Vuestros}} hijos vivirán como pastores en el desierto durante cuarenta años. Sufrirán porque {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} fieles, hasta que el último de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} haya muerto en el desierto.

fr.L: Et vos {{gender:enfants|fils}} seront bergers dans le désert pendant quarante ans, et ils porteront votre prostitution jusqu’à ce que vos cadavres soient au complet dans le désert.
fr.B: Vos {{gender:enfants|fils}} erreront dans le désert comme des bergers pendant quarante ans, portant le poids de votre infidélité, jusqu’à ce que tous vos corps soient tombés dans le désert.
fr.R: Vos {{gender:enfants|fils}} vivront comme des bergers dans le désert pendant quarante ans. Ils souffriront parce que vous {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}avez été infidèles, jusqu’à ce que le dernier d’entre vous soit mort dans le désert.

sw.L: Na watoto wenu watakuwa wachungaji nyikani miaka arobaini, nao watabeba ukahaba wenu mpaka maiti zenu zitimie nyikani.
sw.B: Watoto wenu watatangatanga nyikani kama wachungaji kwa miaka arobaini, wakibeba mzigo wa kukosa kwenu uaminifu, hadi miili yenu yote itakapokuwa imeanguka nyikani.
sw.R: Watoto wenu wataishi jangwani kama wachungaji kwa miaka arobaini. Wataumia kwa sababu hamkuwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}, mpaka wa mwisho wenu atakapokufa jangwani.

decisions.choice: shepherds in the wilderness: living as wandering herders
decisions.reason: Shepherds moved from pasture to pasture with their flocks. The next generation will live this way, without a settled home, for forty years.

decisions.choice: bear your prostitution: suffer the consequences of your unfaithfulness
decisions.reason: The word means prostitution, and is used as a picture for Israel's unfaithfulness to the LORD, as of a wife who leaves her husband (Exodus 34:15-16; Hosea 1:2). To "bear" it is to carry its consequences. The verb is the one used of God "bearing" sin in verses 18-19: what God bore in forgiveness, the people now bear in judgment.

decisions.choice: until are finished: until the last of them has died
decisions.reason: The verb means to come to an end, to be complete: the forty years last until the whole generation is gone.

decisions.choice: unfaithfulness (Balanced); you were not faithful to me (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the picture rather than the picture itself; Literal keeps "prostitution". Readable adds "to me" to show whom they were unfaithful to.

source.text: בְּמִסְפַּ֨ר הַיָּמִ֜ים אֲשֶׁר־תַּרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־הָאָרֶץ֮ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים יוֹם֒ י֣וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֞ה י֣וֹם לַשָּׁנָ֗ה תִּשְׂאוּ֙ אֶת־עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־תְּנוּאָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: By [the] number of the days which you spied out the land, forty days, a day for the year, a day for the year, you will bear your iniquities forty years, and you will know my opposition.

en.L: By the number of the days which you spied out the land, forty days, a day for the year, a day for the year, you will bear your iniquities forty years, and you will know {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} opposition.
en.B: You spent forty days exploring the land; for each day you will bear your guilt for a year, forty years in all, and you will learn what {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} opposition means.
en.R: You explored the land for forty days. So you will suffer for your sins for forty years, one year for each day. Then you will find out what happens when I oppose you.

es.L: Según el número de los días en que {{plural_you:exploraron|explorasteis}} la tierra, cuarenta días, un día por año, un día por año, {{plural_you:cargarán|cargaréis}} con {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} iniquidades cuarenta años, y {{plural_you:conocerán|conoceréis}} {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} oposición.
es.B: {{plural_you:Pasaron|Pasasteis}} cuarenta días explorando la tierra; por cada día {{plural_you:cargarán|cargaréis}} con {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} culpa un año, cuarenta años en total, y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} lo que significa {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} oposición.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes exploraron|Vosotros explorasteis}} la tierra durante cuarenta días. Por eso {{plural_you:sufrirán|sufriréis}} por {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} pecados durante cuarenta años, un año por cada día. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} lo que pasa cuando yo estoy en contra de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}.

fr.L: Selon le nombre des jours pendant lesquels vous avez exploré le pays, quarante jours, un jour pour l’année, un jour pour l’année, vous porterez vos fautes quarante ans, et vous connaîtrez {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} opposition.
fr.B: Vous avez passé quarante jours à explorer le pays ; pour chaque jour vous porterez votre faute une année, quarante ans en tout, et vous apprendrez ce que signifie {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} opposition.
fr.R: Vous avez exploré le pays pendant quarante jours. Alors vous allez souffrir pour vos péchés pendant quarante ans, une année pour chaque jour. Vous saurez alors ce qui arrive quand je suis contre vous.

sw.L: Kwa hesabu ya siku mlizoipeleleza nchi, siku arobaini, siku moja kwa mwaka, siku moja kwa mwaka, mtabeba maovu yenu miaka arobaini, nanyi mtaujua upinzani {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Mlitumia siku arobaini kuipeleleza nchi; kwa kila siku mtabeba hatia yenu mwaka mmoja, miaka arobaini kwa jumla, nanyi mtajua maana ya upinzani {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.R: Mliipeleleza nchi kwa siku arobaini. Kwa hiyo mtateseka kwa ajili ya dhambi zenu kwa miaka arobaini, mwaka mmoja kwa kila siku. Ndipo mtajua kinachotokea {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ninapowapinga.

decisions.choice: a day for the year, a day for the year: one year for each day
decisions.reason: The phrase is repeated to make the measure exact: each of the forty days of the spying (13:25) becomes a year in the wilderness. Ezekiel 4:6 uses the same measure.

decisions.choice: bear your iniquities: carry the guilt and its punishment
decisions.reason: The word for iniquity means both the wrong done and the guilt and punishment that follow it (Genesis 4:13). To bear it is to suffer its consequences. Compare verse 33.

decisions.choice: my opposition: my turning against you
decisions.reason: The word is rare. It comes from a verb meaning to hinder or frustrate (32:7, 9; 30:6) and seems to mean God's opposition or displeasure, his setting himself against them. In Job 33:10 a related word means grounds for hostility.

decisions.choice: You spent forty days exploring the land; for each day ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the forty days first in a sentence of their own and then give the forty years.

source.text: אֲנִ֣י יְהוָה֮ דִּבַּרְתִּי֒ אִם־לֹ֣א׀זֹ֣את אֶֽעֱשֶׂ֗ה לְכָל־הָעֵדָ֤ה הָֽרָעָה֙ הַזֹּ֔את הַנּוֹעָדִ֖ים עָלָ֑י בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר הַזֶּ֛ה יִתַּ֖מּוּ וְשָׁ֥ם יָמֻֽתוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I, Yahweh, have spoken; surely this I will do to all the congregation the evil the this who have gathered together against me; in the wilderness the this they will come to an end, and there they will die.

en.L: I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken: surely this I will do to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. In this wilderness they will come to an end, and there they will die.'"
en.B: I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken. I will surely do this to this whole evil congregation that has banded together against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: in this wilderness they will come to their end, and here they will die.'"
en.R: I, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, have spoken. I will certainly do these things to this whole evil community that has joined together against {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. They will all die here in this desert.'"

es.L: Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado: ciertamente esto haré a toda esta comunidad malvada que se ha juntado contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. En este desierto llegarán a su fin, y allí morirán”».
es.B: Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, he hablado. Ciertamente haré esto a toda esta comunidad malvada que se ha confabulado contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}: en este desierto llegarán a su fin, y aquí morirán”».
es.R: Yo, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, lo he dicho. Sin falta haré estas cosas a toda esta comunidad malvada que se ha unido contra {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Todos morirán aquí, en este desierto”».

fr.L: Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé : certainement, c’est ainsi que je ferai à toute cette communauté mauvaise qui s’est rassemblée contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Dans ce désert ils prendront fin, et là ils mourront.” »
fr.B: Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé. Oui, voilà ce que je ferai à toute cette communauté mauvaise qui s’est liguée contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} : dans ce désert ils trouveront leur fin, et c’est ici qu’ils mourront.” »
fr.R: Moi, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, j’ai parlé. C’est sûr, je ferai tout cela à cette communauté mauvaise qui s’est unie contre {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Ils vont tous mourir ici, dans ce désert.” »

sw.L: Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema: hakika nitaitendea hivi jumuiya hii yote ovu iliyokusanyika pamoja dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Katika nyika hii wataangamia, na huko watakufa.'"
sw.B: Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema. Hakika nitaitendea hivi jumuiya hii yote ovu iliyoungana dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}: katika nyika hii watafikia mwisho wao, na hapa ndipo watakapokufa.'"
sw.R: Mimi, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nimesema. Hakika nitaitendea mambo haya jumuiya hii yote mbaya iliyoungana dhidi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}. Wote watakufa hapa katika jangwa hili.'"

decisions.choice: I, the LORD, have spoken: a seal on the sentence
decisions.reason: God names himself to confirm that what he has said will happen. The oath form "surely" follows, as in verse 28.

decisions.choice: gathered together against me: joined as one against God
decisions.reason: The verb means to meet by appointment, to assemble; here the people have gathered as a body against the LORD. The same verb is used of Korah's company (16:11; 27:3).

decisions.choice: They will all die here in this desert.
decisions.reason: Readable joins "come to an end" and "die" into one plain statement.

source.text: וְהָ֣אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה לָת֣וּר אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיָּשֻׁ֗בוּ וַיַּלִּ֤ינוּ עָלָיו֙ אֶת־כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לְהוֹצִ֥יא דִבָּ֖ה עַל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the men whom sent Moses to spy out the land, and they returned and made grumble against him all the congregation by bringing out a bad report about the land,

en.L: And the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, and [who] returned and made all the congregation grumble against him by bringing out a bad report about the land,
en.B: As for the men Moses had sent to explore the land, who came back and made the whole congregation grumble against him by spreading a bad report about the land,
en.R: Moses had sent men to explore the land. Some of them came back and spread a bad report about it, and that made the whole community complain against Moses.

es.L: Y los hombres que Moisés envió a explorar la tierra, y [que] volvieron e hicieron murmurar contra él a toda la comunidad sacando un mal informe sobre la tierra,
es.B: En cuanto a los hombres que Moisés había enviado a explorar la tierra, que volvieron e hicieron que toda la comunidad murmurara contra él al difundir un mal informe sobre la tierra,
es.R: Moisés había enviado a unos hombres a explorar la tierra. Algunos de ellos volvieron y difundieron un mal informe sobre ella, y eso hizo que toda la comunidad se quejara contra Moisés.

fr.L: Et les hommes que Moïse avait envoyés pour explorer le pays, et [qui] revinrent et firent murmurer contre lui toute la communauté en répandant un mauvais rapport sur le pays,
fr.B: Quant aux hommes que Moïse avait envoyés explorer le pays, qui étaient revenus et avaient fait murmurer toute la communauté contre lui en répandant un rapport malveillant sur le pays,
fr.R: Moïse avait envoyé des hommes pour explorer le pays. Certains d’entre eux sont revenus et ont répandu de mauvaises nouvelles sur ce pays, et à cause de cela toute la communauté s’est plainte contre Moïse.

sw.L: Na wale watu ambao Musa aliwatuma kuipeleleza nchi, [ambao] walirudi na kuifanya jumuiya yote imnung'unikie kwa kuleta habari mbaya juu ya nchi,
sw.B: Na wale watu ambao Musa alikuwa amewatuma kuipeleleza nchi, waliorudi na kuifanya jumuiya yote imnung'unikie kwa kueneza habari mbaya kuhusu nchi,
sw.R: Musa alikuwa amewatuma watu kuipeleleza nchi. Baadhi yao walirudi na kueneza habari mbaya kuhusu nchi hiyo, na jambo hilo likaifanya jumuiya nzima imlalamikie Musa.

decisions.choice: made all the congregation grumble: the reading the scribes marked
alternatives: they grumbled against him, with all the congregation
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text (ketiv) can be read "they grumbled against him with all the congregation"; the reading the scribes marked (qere), followed here, is "they made all the congregation grumble against him". The second fits the end of the verse: they caused the grumbling by their report. Either way, the spies stand at the root of the people's revolt.

decisions.choice: bringing out a bad report: spreading a damaging account
decisions.reason: The word means an evil report or slander, a story that runs something down (13:32; Genesis 37:2). They did not simply report what they saw; they spread a picture of the land meant to make the people afraid.

decisions.choice: the men whom Moses sent ...: the subject of verse 37
decisions.reason: The verse names the men and what they did; verse 37 finishes the sentence: they died.

decisions.choice: ends with a comma
decisions.reason: The sentence runs on into verse 37, so Literal and Balanced end with a comma. Readable makes complete sentences of its own.

decisions.choice: Some of them
decisions.reason: Readable says "some of them", since Joshua and Caleb, who were also sent, did not do this (verse 38).

source.text: וַיָּמֻ֨תוּ֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים מוֹצִאֵ֥י דִבַּת־הָאָ֖רֶץ רָעָ֑ה בַּמַּגֵּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and died the men bringing out [the] report of the land, evil, by the plague before Yahweh.

en.L: those men who brought out the evil report of the land died by the plague before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: those men who spread the evil report about the land died by a plague in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Those men who spread the bad report about the land died. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} struck them with a plague.

es.L: esos hombres que sacaron el mal informe de la tierra murieron por la plaga delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: esos hombres que difundieron el mal informe sobre la tierra murieron de una plaga en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Esos hombres que difundieron el mal informe sobre la tierra murieron. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} los hirió con una plaga.

fr.L: ces hommes qui avaient répandu le mauvais rapport sur le pays moururent par le fléau devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: ces hommes qui avaient répandu le rapport malveillant sur le pays moururent d’un fléau en présence {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ces hommes qui avaient répandu de mauvaises nouvelles sur le pays sont morts. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} les a frappés d’un fléau.

sw.L: watu hao walioleta habari mbaya ya nchi walikufa kwa pigo mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: watu hao walioeneza habari mbaya kuhusu nchi walikufa kwa pigo mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu hao walioeneza habari mbaya kuhusu nchi walikufa. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaletea pigo.

decisions.choice: the plague: a sudden deadly blow
decisions.reason: The word means a blow or stroke, a deadly plague sent by God (17:13-15; 25:8-9). It came on the ten spies at once, while the rest of the generation was given forty years.

decisions.choice: before the LORD: in the LORD's presence, by his act
decisions.reason: "Before the LORD" places their death in front of the tent where his glory had appeared (verse 10). It was a judgment from God, not an accident.

decisions.choice: The LORD struck them with a plague.
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "by the plague before the LORD" implies: the LORD sent it.

source.text: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־נ֔וּן וְכָלֵ֖ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֑ה חָיוּ֙ מִן־הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם הַֽהֹלְכִ֖ים לָת֥וּר אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh lived, from the men those who went to spy out the land.

en.L: And Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh lived, of those men who went to spy out the land.
en.B: But Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh remained alive, the only two left of the men who had gone to explore the land.
en.R: Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh were the only ones of those men who stayed alive.

es.L: Y Josué hijo de Nun y Caleb hijo de Jefone vivieron, de aquellos hombres que fueron a explorar la tierra.
es.B: Pero Josué hijo de Nun y Caleb hijo de Jefone quedaron con vida, los únicos que sobrevivieron de los hombres que habían ido a explorar la tierra.
es.R: Josué hijo de Nun y Caleb hijo de Jefone fueron los únicos de aquellos hombres que siguieron con vida.

fr.L: Et Josué fils de Noun et Caleb fils de Jephounné vécurent, d’entre ces hommes qui étaient allés explorer le pays.
fr.B: Mais Josué fils de Noun et Caleb fils de Jephounné restèrent en vie, les deux seuls survivants des hommes qui étaient allés parcourir le pays.
fr.R: Josué, fils de Noun, et Caleb, fils de Jephounné, ont été les seuls de ces hommes à rester en vie.

sw.L: Na Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na Kalebu mwana wa Yefune waliishi, wa wale watu waliokwenda kuipeleleza nchi.
sw.B: Lakini Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na Kalebu mwana wa Yefune walibaki hai, wawili pekee waliosalia kati ya watu waliokwenda kuipeleleza nchi.
sw.R: Yoshua mwana wa Nuni na Kalebu mwana wa Yefune ndio pekee kati ya watu wale waliobaki hai.

decisions.choice: lived: spared from the plague
decisions.reason: Of the twelve who went, only the two who trusted the LORD survived, as he had said (verses 24, 30). Their survival marks them as the ones who will enter the land.

decisions.choice: the only two left / the only ones
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "only", which is clear from verses 37-38 together: all the others died.

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֶֽל־כָּל־בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּֽתְאַבְּל֥וּ הָעָ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke Moses the words the these to all [the] sons of Israel, and mourned the people greatly.

en.L: And Moses spoke these words to all the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.
en.B: Moses reported these words to all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}, and the people grieved deeply.
en.R: Moses told all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said, and the people were filled with grief.

es.L: Y habló Moisés estas palabras a todos los hijos de Israel, y el pueblo se enlutó mucho.
es.B: Moisés comunicó estas palabras a todos los israelitas, y el pueblo se llenó de profundo dolor.
es.R: Moisés les contó a todos los israelitas lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho, y la gente se llenó de tristeza.

fr.L: Et Moïse dit ces paroles à tous les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, et le peuple mena un grand deuil.
fr.B: Moïse rapporta ces paroles à tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, et le peuple fut profondément affligé.
fr.R: Moïse a raconté à tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dit, et le peuple a été rempli de tristesse.

sw.L: Na Musa akawaambia wana wote wa Israeli maneno haya, na watu wakaomboleza sana.
sw.B: Musa aliwaeleza Waisraeli wote maneno haya, na watu wakahuzunika sana.
sw.R: Musa aliwaeleza Waisraeli wote yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amesema, nao watu wakajawa na huzuni.

decisions.choice: mourned: grieved as for the dead
decisions.reason: The verb is used of mourning for the dead (Genesis 37:34). The people grieve over the sentence, but verse 40 shows that their grief did not lead them to accept it.

decisions.choice: what the LORD had said
decisions.reason: "These words" are the LORD's words in verses 26-35; Readable says so.

source.text: וַיַּשְׁכִּ֣מוּ בַבֹּ֔קֶר וַיַּֽעֲל֥וּ אֶל־רֹאשׁ־הָהָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֶּ֗נּוּ וְעָלִ֛ינוּ אֶל־הַמָּק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־אָמַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And they rose early in the morning and went up to [the] top of the hill country, saying, here we [are], and we will go up to the place which said Yahweh, for we have sinned.

en.L: And they rose early in the morning and went up to the top of the hill country, saying, "Here we [are], and we will go up to the place which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, for we have sinned."
en.B: They got up early in the morning and went up toward the heights of the hill country, saying, "Here we are! We will go up to the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke of, for we have sinned."
en.R: Early the next morning the people started up into the high hill country. They said, "We are ready now. We will go to the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised us. We admit that we sinned."

es.L: Y madrugaron por la mañana y subieron a la cima de la región montañosa, diciendo: «Aquí [estamos], y subiremos al lugar que dijo {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque hemos pecado».
es.B: A la mañana siguiente se levantaron temprano y subieron hacia las alturas de la región montañosa, diciendo: «¡Aquí estamos! Subiremos al lugar del que habló {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, porque hemos pecado».
es.R: Temprano a la mañana siguiente, la gente empezó a subir a la región alta de las montañas. Decían: «Ahora estamos listos. Iremos al lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos prometió. Reconocemos que hemos pecado».

fr.L: Et ils se levèrent de bon matin et montèrent vers le sommet de la montagne, en disant : « Nous voici, et nous monterons au lieu dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé, car nous avons péché. »
fr.B: Ils se levèrent tôt le matin et montèrent vers les hauteurs de la région montagneuse, en disant : « Nous voici ! Nous allons monter jusqu’au lieu dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a parlé, car nous avons péché. »
fr.R: Tôt le lendemain matin, le peuple a commencé à monter vers les hauteurs de la région montagneuse. Ils disaient : « Maintenant, nous sommes prêts. Nous allons aller à l’endroit que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous a promis. Nous reconnaissons que nous avons péché. »

sw.L: Wakaamka asubuhi na mapema, wakapanda mpaka kilele cha nchi ya milima, wakisema, "Sisi hapa, nasi tutapanda mpaka mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alipasema, kwa maana tumetenda dhambi."
sw.B: Waliamka asubuhi na mapema, wakapanda kuelekea vilele vya nchi ya milima, wakisema, "Sisi hapa! Tutapanda mpaka mahali alipotaja {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana tumetenda dhambi."
sw.R: Kesho yake asubuhi na mapema watu walianza kupanda kuelekea nchi ya milima mirefu. Wakasema, "Sasa tuko tayari. Tutakwenda mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alituahidi. Tunakiri kwamba tumetenda dhambi."

decisions.choice: went up to the top of the hill country: set out to climb into the heights
decisions.reason: The "hill country" is the high land of southern Canaan that the spies had gone up into (13:17). "Went up" here begins the attempt that verse 44 describes; Moses speaks to them before they reach the top (verses 41-43).

decisions.choice: for we have sinned: an admission that comes too late
decisions.reason: The people admit their sin and think that going now will undo it. But the LORD has already said what will happen (verses 28-35), and his command now is to turn back (verse 25).

decisions.choice: the place which the LORD said: the place he promised
decisions.reason: "Said" here means said he would give: the land of the promise (10:29).

decisions.choice: promised us
decisions.reason: Readable says "promised" for "said", since the LORD had spoken of giving them the land.

decisions.choice: We are ready now
decisions.reason: "Here we are" says they are present and ready to act; Readable says it plainly.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָ֥מָּה זֶּ֛ה אַתֶּ֥ם עֹבְרִ֖ים אֶת־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהִ֖וא לֹ֥א תִצְלָֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Moses, why this [are] you transgressing the mouth of Yahweh? And it will not succeed.

en.L: And Moses said, "Why [is] this [that] you are transgressing the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? It will not succeed.
en.B: But Moses said, "Why are you doing this, going against what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has commanded? It will not work.
en.R: But Moses said, "Why are you doing what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told you not to do? Your plan will fail.

es.L: Y dijo Moisés: «¿Por qué es esto [que] {{plural_you:están|estáis}} traspasando el mandato {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? Esto no prosperará.
es.B: Pero Moisés dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} esto, yendo contra lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha mandado? No {{plural_you:les|os}} saldrá bien.
es.R: Pero Moisés dijo: «¿Por qué {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} {{plural_you:les|os}} dijo que no {{plural_you:hicieran|hicierais}}? {{plural_you:Su|Vuestro}} plan va a fracasar.

fr.L: Et Moïse dit : « Pourquoi donc [est-ce que] vous transgressez l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Cela ne réussira pas.
fr.B: Mais Moïse dit : « Pourquoi agissez-vous ainsi, en allant contre ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a ordonné ? Cela ne marchera pas.
fr.R: Mais Moïse a dit : « Pourquoi faites-vous ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vous a dit de ne pas faire ? Votre projet va échouer.

sw.L: Na Musa akasema, "Kwa nini hili, [kwamba] mnavunja amri ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Halitafanikiwa.
sw.B: Lakini Musa akasema, "Kwa nini mnafanya hivi, mkienda kinyume cha alichoamuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Hamtafanikiwa.
sw.R: Lakini Musa akasema, "Kwa nini mnafanya kitu ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwaambia msifanye? Mpango wenu utashindwa.

decisions.choice: transgressing the mouth of the LORD: disobeying his command
decisions.reason: "The mouth" of the LORD means what he has spoken, his command; to "pass over" it is to break it. His command was to turn back into the wilderness (verse 25).

decisions.choice: why this: why now, why are you doing this
decisions.reason: The small word "this" strengthens the question, as in "why ever". Having refused to go when the LORD said go, they now go when he says turn back.

decisions.choice: the command of
decisions.reason: Literal gives the meaning of "the mouth of" here, as an idiom English cannot bear. The gloss keeps the word.

decisions.choice: doing what the LORD told you not to do
decisions.reason: Readable says in plain words what breaking the LORD's command meant.

source.text: אַֽל־תַּעֲל֔וּ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין יְהוָ֖ה בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְלֹא֙ תִּנָּ֣גְפ֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not go up, for not [is] Yahweh in your midst, and not you will be struck down before your enemies.

en.L: Do not go up, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] not in your midst, so that you are not struck down before your enemies.
en.B: Do not go up, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is not in your midst; do not let your enemies strike you down.
en.R: Do not go up there. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is not with you, and your enemies will defeat you.

es.L: No {{plural_you:suban|subáis}}, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no [está] en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, para que no {{plural_you:sean derrotados|seáis derrotados}} delante de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos.
es.B: No {{plural_you:suban|subáis}}, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no está en medio de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos {{plural_you:los|os}} derroten.
es.R: No {{plural_you:suban|subáis}} allá. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no está con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} enemigos {{plural_you:los|os}} van a derrotar.

fr.L: Ne montez pas, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [n’est] pas au milieu de vous, afin que vous ne soyez pas battus devant vos ennemis.
fr.B: Ne montez pas, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’est pas au milieu de vous ; ne vous laissez pas abattre par vos ennemis.
fr.R: Ne montez pas là-haut. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} n’est pas avec vous, et vos ennemis vont vous battre.

sw.L: Msipande, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [hayuko] katikati yenu, ili msipigwe mbele ya adui zenu.
sw.B: Msipande, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hayuko katikati yenu; msikubali adui zenu wawaangushe.
sw.R: Msipande huko. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hayuko pamoja nanyi, na adui zenu watawashinda.

decisions.choice: the LORD is not in your midst: Israel's strength was God's presence
decisions.reason: Joshua and Caleb had said, "the LORD is with us" (verse 9). Now that the people have refused him, he will not go with them, and without him they cannot win (Deuteronomy 1:42). His presence was marked by the ark and the cloud (verse 44; 10:33-36).

decisions.choice: and you will not be struck down: the purpose of the warning
decisions.reason: The clause gives the reason for the command: do not go, so that you are not defeated. It is a warning, not a promise.

decisions.choice: your enemies will defeat you
decisions.reason: Readable states the outcome the warning is meant to prevent, as a plain prediction.

source.text: כִּי֩ הָעֲמָלֵקִ֨י וְהַכְּנַעֲנִ֥י שָׁם֙ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם וּנְפַלְתֶּ֖ם בֶּחָ֑רֶב כִּֽי־עַל־כֵּ֤ן שַׁבְתֶּם֙ מֵאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וְלֹא־יִהְיֶ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּכֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For the Amalekite and the Canaanite [are] there before you, and you will fall by [the] sword, for because you have turned back from after Yahweh, and not will be Yahweh with you.

en.L: For the Amalekite and the Canaanite [are] there before you, and you will fall by the sword; because you have turned back from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not be with you."
en.B: The Amalekites and the Canaanites are there ahead of you, and you will fall by the sword. Because you have turned away from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not be with you."
en.R: The Amalekites and the Canaanites are there ahead of you, and they will kill you in battle. You have turned away from following {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, so {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will not be with you."

es.L: Porque el amalecita y el cananeo [están] allí delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:caerán|caeréis}} a espada; porque {{plural_you:se han apartado|os habéis apartado}} de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no estará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».
es.B: Los amalecitas y los cananeos están allí delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:caerán|caeréis}} a espada. Como {{plural_you:se han apartado|os habéis apartado}} de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no estará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».
es.R: Los amalecitas y los cananeos están allí delante de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y {{plural_you:los|os}} matarán en la batalla. {{plural_you:Ustedes han dejado|Vosotros habéis dejado}} de seguir {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, así que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} no estará con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}».

fr.L: Car l’Amalécite et le Cananéen [sont] là devant vous, et vous tomberez par l’épée ; parce que vous vous êtes détournés de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne sera pas avec vous. »
fr.B: Les Amalécites et les Cananéens sont là devant vous, et vous tomberez par l’épée. Puisque vous avez cessé de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne sera pas avec vous. »
fr.R: Les Amalécites et les Cananéens sont là devant vous, et ils vont vous tuer au combat. Vous avez cessé de suivre {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ne sera pas avec vous. »

sw.L: Kwa maana Mwamaleki na Mkanaani [wako] huko mbele yenu, nanyi mtaanguka kwa upanga; kwa sababu mmegeuka nyuma msimfuate {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatakuwa pamoja nanyi."
sw.B: Waamaleki na Wakanaani wako huko mbele yenu, nanyi mtaanguka kwa upanga. Kwa kuwa mmeacha kumfuata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatakuwa pamoja nanyi."
sw.R: Waamaleki na Wakanaani wako huko mbele yenu, nao watawaua vitani. Mmeacha kumfuata {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hatakuwa pamoja nanyi."

decisions.choice: turned back from after the LORD: stopped following him
decisions.reason: To go "after" the LORD is to follow him as a servant follows his master (verse 24, of Caleb). The people turned back from following when they refused the land. The verb "turn back" is the one they used in verses 3-4 of returning to Egypt.

decisions.choice: because: the reason they will fall
decisions.reason: The two small words together mean "because" or "since". They introduce the reason for defeat: the LORD's absence, which follows from their turning away.

decisions.choice: the Amalekites and the Canaanites
decisions.reason: As in verse 25.

decisions.choice: they will kill you in battle
decisions.reason: Readable says what "fall by the sword" means.

records.literal_gloss: But they presumed to go up to [the] top of the hill country; and [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh and Moses not departed from [the] midst of the camp.

en.L: But they presumed to go up to the top of the hill country; and the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and Moses did not depart from the midst of the camp.
en.B: But they recklessly went on up toward the heights of the hill country, though neither the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} nor Moses left the camp.
en.R: But they were stubborn and went up into the high hill country anyway. The ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and Moses stayed in the camp.

es.L: Pero se atrevieron a subir a la cima de la región montañosa; y el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y Moisés no se apartaron de en medio del campamento.
es.B: Pero ellos, temerariamente, siguieron subiendo hacia las alturas de la región montañosa, aunque ni el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ni Moisés salieron del campamento.
es.R: Pero ellos se pusieron tercos y subieron de todos modos a la región alta de las montañas. El arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y Moisés se quedaron en el campamento.

fr.L: Mais ils eurent la témérité de monter vers le sommet de la montagne ; et l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et Moïse ne quittèrent pas le milieu du camp.
fr.B: Mais ils montèrent témérairement vers les hauteurs de la région montagneuse, alors que ni l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ni Moïse ne quittèrent le camp.
fr.R: Mais ils se sont entêtés et sont quand même montés vers les hauteurs de la région montagneuse. L’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et Moïse sont restés dans le camp.

sw.L: Lakini wakathubutu kupanda mpaka kilele cha nchi ya milima; na sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na Musa hawakuondoka katikati ya kambi.
sw.B: Lakini kwa ukaidi waliendelea kupanda kuelekea vilele vya nchi ya milima, ingawa sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na Musa hawakutoka kambini.
sw.R: Lakini walikuwa wakaidi, wakapanda hata hivyo mpaka nchi ya milima mirefu. Sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na Musa walibaki kambini.

decisions.choice: they presumed: they went ahead in defiance
decisions.reason: The verb is rare and seems to mean to be heedless or overbold. Deuteronomy 1:43 describes the same event: "you rebelled against the command of the LORD and acted presumptuously and went up".

decisions.choice: the ark and Moses did not leave the camp: the LORD did not go with them
decisions.reason: The ark was the sign of the LORD's presence going before Israel (10:33-36). It and Moses stayed behind, so the people went up without the LORD and without his servant, as Moses had warned (verse 42).

decisions.choice: were stubborn and went up ... anyway
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of the rare verb with plain words for going ahead against warning.

records.literal_gloss: And came down the Amalekite and the Canaanite who dwelt in the hill country the that, and struck them and crushed them as far as Hormah.

en.L: And the Amalekite and the Canaanite who dwelt in that hill country came down and struck them and crushed them as far as Hormah.
en.B: Then the Amalekites and Canaanites living in that hill country swept down on them, struck them and cut them to pieces as far as Hormah.
en.R: Then the Amalekites and Canaanites who lived in those hills came down and attacked them. They beat Israel badly and chased them as far as Hormah.

es.L: Y descendieron el amalecita y el cananeo que habitaban en aquella región montañosa, y los hirieron y los destrozaron hasta Horma.
es.B: Entonces los amalecitas y los cananeos que vivían en aquella región montañosa bajaron contra ellos, los atacaron y los hicieron pedazos hasta Horma.
es.R: Entonces los amalecitas y los cananeos que vivían en aquellas montañas bajaron y los atacaron. Derrotaron por completo a los israelitas y los persiguieron hasta Horma.

fr.L: Et l’Amalécite et le Cananéen qui habitaient dans cette montagne descendirent, les frappèrent et les écrasèrent jusqu’à Horma.
fr.B: Alors les Amalécites et les Cananéens qui habitaient cette région montagneuse fondirent sur eux, les battirent et les taillèrent en pièces jusqu’à Horma.
fr.R: Alors les Amalécites et les Cananéens qui vivaient dans ces montagnes sont descendus et les ont attaqués. Ils ont complètement battu les Israélites et les ont poursuivis jusqu’à Horma.

sw.L: Ndipo Mwamaleki na Mkanaani waliokaa katika nchi ile ya milima wakashuka, wakawapiga na kuwaponda mpaka Horma.
sw.B: Ndipo Waamaleki na Wakanaani walioishi katika nchi ile ya milima wakawashukia, wakawapiga na kuwavunjavunja mpaka Horma.
sw.R: Ndipo Waamaleki na Wakanaani walioishi katika milima ile wakashuka na kuwashambulia. Waliwashinda Waisraeli vibaya sana, wakawafukuza mpaka Horma.

decisions.choice: crushed them: beat them to pieces
decisions.reason: The verb means to beat or hammer into small pieces (Deuteronomy 9:21). It describes a rout; Deuteronomy 1:44 says the enemy chased Israel "as bees do".

decisions.choice: Hormah: a town in the south of Canaan
decisions.reason: Hormah lay in the Negev, the dry south (Joshua 15:30). Its name sounds like the word for "devote to destruction", and in 21:1-3 Israel later destroys the towns there and names the place Hormah. Here it marks how far south Israel was driven back.

decisions.choice: chased them as far as Hormah
decisions.reason: "As far as Hormah" implies a pursuit; Readable says "chased", as Deuteronomy 1:44 describes.

decisions.choice: the Amalekites and Canaanites
decisions.reason: As in verse 25.
